description: This is a Java source file for an Android service class named SampleHotwordDetectionService, which extends HotwordDetectionService. It implements functionality for hotword detection using Android's voice recognition APIs, manages AudioRecord instances for capturing audio upon hotword detection, and includes methods for handling state updates and detection callbacks.

classes.name: SampleHotwordDetectionService
classes.description: An Android service class that handles hotword detection events, manages audio recording sessions, and processes detection results.

methods.name: createAudioRecord
methods.description: Creates and configures an AudioRecord instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: getBufferSizeInBytes
methods.description: Calculates buffer size in bytes based on byte rate and buffer duration.

methods.name: onUpdateState
methods.description: Handles state update requests, with an optional callback.

methods.name: onDetect
methods.description: Handles the hotword detection event, initializes audio recording, reads audio data, and triggers detection callback.

methods.name: getKeyphraseId
methods.description: Returns an integer keyphrase ID associated with the detection event payload.
